messages:
Matt (AE): Kicking off a thread for Velari Health POC — want to align on top priorities, endpoints, timeline, and any enterprise blockers. They called out clinician triage, note generation, and fast chart search as must-haves.

Jess (SE): Quick take — minimal endpoints to build the pilot: `POST /v1/generate-note`, `POST /v1/triage-query`, `POST /v1/embeddings/query`. Recommend keeping sequence length ~2048 for notes to control cost.

Anika (Prospect): Confirming our priorities: 1) triage assistant (low latency) 2) clinician note generation (high quality + templates) 3) chart search (embeddings). Target pilot length = 6 weeks.

Ryan (Solutions): For evaluation we'll provide 5 prompt families per journey + a separate holdout set. Proposed success criteria: triage p95 latency < 350ms, note quality ROUGE-L >= 0.45 on our prompts, and embeddings recall@10 >= 0.7 on the chart search benchmarks.

Jess (SE): I'll assemble prompt sets and a lightweight eval harness (python + notebook). Model recommendation: start with a quantized mid-sized model on Dedicated for predictable perf. If cost becomes an issue we can trial a hosted smaller variant.

Sam (Security): They raised SOC2 + data residency questions. Need to confirm KMS/HSM key rotation, VPC egress rules, and audit log retention. I'll send our standard redacted security checklist. @Anika who on your side owns compliance?

Anika (Prospect): Compliance lead is Laura (laura@velari.com). Also they require data residency in `us-east-1` for the pilot and want clarification on temporary storage of prompts during evals.

Matt (AE): Pricing note from buyer: they'd prefer a single capped pilot fee rather than pay-as-you-go. Suggested commercial approach: fixed pilot fee to cover baseline capacity + a clear overage per-token rate. @Jess can you give a rough ops cost for 6-week pilot given their expected load (peak ~50 req/s, avg 15 req/s)?

Jess (SE): Very rough infra estimate: ~4M tokens/day => ~ $2.4k infra for Dedicated burst plus buffer for canary/fallback. I can refine after we get sample traces. We'll include automatic fallback to hosted if Dedicated capacity is saturated.

deploy-bot: deployment note: canary rollout scheduled for 2026-04-08T10:00Z if smoke tests pass. :white_check_mark:

Ryan (Solutions): Major blockers to close pre-kickoff: 1) signed pilot MSA with capped fee 2) answered SOC2 questionnaire 3) redacted sample dataset (PHI-free) for prompt tuning 4) staging VPC access or temporary credentials. If any slip, add ~2 weeks to timeline.

Matt (AE): Next actions — 1) Jess: send prompt/eval templates and initial ops estimate by EOD 2) Sam: send redacted security checklist + KMS integration notes 3) Anika: confirm legal contact & share dataset or dataset constraints 4) Ryan: draft success-criteria doc and acceptance test list. I'll send a kickoff invite once items 1-3 are in flight. :thumbsup:
